compute_attribution_saliency_maps: compute attribution saliency maps for subregions and dates given model forward pass and parameters
beam_search_batch_2d: run non-sequential beam search to predict masked text positions with configurable beam width and nucleus sampling
beam_search_batch_1d: run sequential beam search to predict masked text positions one character at a time with nucleus sampling support
sequential_restoration_saliency: greedily restore masked characters one at a time yielding per-step saliency maps for each restored position
predicted_dates: compute mode and mean date predictions from date probability distribution over a year range
